IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Senate Committee on Natural Resources, Energy & Water (originally sponsored by Senators Hargrove, Morton and Doumit)

Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting certain forest practices from the environmental impact statement requirements of chapter 43.21C RCW.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the state environmental policy act requirementsfor class I, II, and III forest practices on state trust lands; addinga new section to chapter 43.21C RCW; and adding a new section tochapter 79.68 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.21C RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any decision or action of the department of natural resources andthe board of natural resources concerning state trust lands are exemptfrom all of the procedural requirements for the preparation of anenvironmental impact statement or the making of a thresholddetermination required by this chapter for class I, II, and III forestpractices as defined by rules adopted by the forest practices boardunder RCW 76.09.050. Such forest practices include timber sales by thedepartment of natural resources and the board of natural resources.State trust lands include federally granted trust lands, forest boardtransfer lands, forest board purchase lands, and the community collegereserve trust lands.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 79.68 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: State trust lands are subject to the provisions of section 1 ofthis act.
